# SaveAny

SaveAny is a web-based universal video downloader and AI video understanding tool.

## Product Summary

SaveAny helps users parse public video URLs, choose available media formats, download videos through a server-side workflow, extract subtitles, and generate AI summaries, mind maps, and Q&A context from video transcripts.

## Main Capabilities

- Public video URL parsing and format selection.
- Server-side video download powered by yt-dlp.
- Platform subtitle and automatic caption extraction.
- AI video summaries, keywords, mind maps, and content Q&A.
- Optional local ASR fallback for videos without platform subtitles during testing.

## Important Limitations

- SaveAny is intended for lawful personal backup, learning, and accessibility use cases.
- It does not promise to bypass DRM, paywalls, private content, or platform access restrictions.
- High-resolution availability depends on the platform, account permission, login state, and video source.
- ASR fallback is under local testing and should be enabled explicitly in controlled environments.
